bio.text: Dave Koehler has represented the 46th District in the Illinois Senate since December 2006, when Koehler was appointed after being elected in November 2006.
According to the legislature's biography, Koehler served on the Peoria County Board from 1982 to 1988 and on the Peoria City Council from 1989 to 1997.
Koehler's earlier work included positions at the National Farm Worker Ministry, Peoria Friendship House, and the Peoria Area Labor Management Council.
